title: High resolution labeling of mucosal vagal afferent fibers using Dextran-Biotin with counterstaining
author: Terry Powley
materials: For dextran injections, each anesthetized animal was placed in a supine position, and a midline incision of the skin of the ventral neck was made. Both nodose ganglia were then exposed by blunt dissection of the overlying muscles. Each animal received bilateral injections (1 μl per ganglion) of lysine-fixable dextran biotin solution consisting of a 1:1 mixture of 3K and 10K MW dextrans in ultrapure DI water or PBS - final concentration 15% dextran biotin consisting of 7.5% each of Dextran-Biotin 3k, Lysine fixable Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #D7135 and Dextran-Biotin 10k, Lysine fixable Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #D1956 (RRID: RRID:AB_2307337) Injections were performed with a 35-gauge NANOFIL needle World Precision Instruments Catalog #NF35BV-2 and 10 microliter Nanofil syringe World Precision Instruments Catalog #Nanofil To control the injection placement and to check the distribution of the tracer within the ganglia under direct visual control, Fast Green FCF Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #F7252 was added to the dextran tracer (0.01 mg per 100 μl solution).

If no counterstaining is wanted - proceed directly to the slide mounting section. For gastrin counterstaining use this section and then proceed to slide mounting; for ghrelin counterstaining use the next section and then proceed to slide mounting. Rinse 3x10min in PBS, then soak for 48 hours in 2% PBST, 0.08% Na Azide, 5% NDS, 2% BSA at 4°C. Normal Donkey Serum Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #D9663-10ml Bovine Serum Albumin Jackson ImmunoResearch Laboratories, Inc. Catalog #001-000-173

steps.title: Prepare and fast animals
steps.instruction: House 2‑ to 4‑month‑old male Sprague‑Dawley (RRID: RGD_737903) rats (180–360 g) individually in wire hanging or vented plastic cages in an AAALAC‑approved room (22–24 °C, 40–60 % humidity) on a 12 h light/dark cycle; provide 2018 Teklad 18 % protein chow and filtered tap water ad libitum, then remove food (but not water) the night before tracer injection.

steps.title: Anesthetize and premedicate
steps.instruction: Induce anesthesia with Isoflurane (Akorn Catalog #NDC:59399‑106‑01) at 5 % then maintain at ≤2 % as needed; inject Glycopyrrolate (0.2 mg ml⁻¹, s.c.) to reduce secretions.

steps.title: Inject tracer and close incisions
steps.instruction: Inject the tracer into both ganglia as described, then close muscle and skin incisions with interrupted sutures.

steps.title: Post‑operative care and analgesia
steps.instruction: Transfer the animal to a circulating‑water heating pad until righting reflexes return, then to its home cage; give Buprenorphine (Buprenex, Midwest Veterinary Catalog #191.26890.3) 0.01 mg kg⁻¹ s.c. prior to suturing and again the following morning; provide a bowl of chow mash (chow mixed with water) that evening and return to solid chow the next day.

steps.title: Survival period
steps.instruction: Allow the animal to survive for 14 days to permit optimal tracer transport.

steps.title: Euthanize and perfuse transcardially
steps.instruction: Administer a lethal dose of sodium pentobarbital (180 mg kg⁻¹, i.p.) **or** ketamine (275 mg kg⁻¹, Patterson Veterinary Catalog #07‑803‑6637) plus xylazine (27.5 mg kg⁻¹, Akorn Catalog #NDC:59399‑110‑20) while the animal has ad libitum food; when unresponsive to nociceptive pinching, perform a midline abdominal incision, inject 0.5 ml Heparin (1000 U ml⁻¹, Henry Schein Catalog #049130) into the heart, and transcardially perfuse first with physiological saline then with 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4). Immediately after perfusion begins, flush the gastrointestinal (GI) tract with 4 % PFA solution.

steps.title: Dissect GI tract and fix blocks
steps.instruction: Transect the distal esophagus and proximal colon, remove the entire GI tract, cut 4 mm tissue blocks from desired regions, and place them in 4 % PFA overnight.

steps.title: ABC incubation for biotin detection
steps.instruction: Rinse blocks 3 × 10 min in 0.3 % PBST, then incubate 48 h at 4 °C in Vectastain Elite ABC HRP kit (Vector #PK‑6100) with bottles A and B each diluted 1:50 in 0.5 % PBST (mix 30 min before use).

steps.title: Microscope scanning and tracing
steps.instruction: Systematically scan sections on a Leica DMRE or DM5500 microscope, identify mucosal afferents, and trace them using Neurolucida 360 (MBF BioScience) on a Zeiss Axio Imager Z2 equipped with DIC optics and long‑working‑distance ×40 and ×63 oil objectives; perform morphometric analysis with Neurolucida Explorer.

steps.title: Prepare gelatin solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare 750 ml each of 5 %, 10 % and 15 % gelatin (by weight) in ultrapure water: add 0.75 mg thymol (Fisher Scientific Catalog #AC150331000) to 750 ml water, stir on a hot plate at 45 °C until dissolved (~30 min); remove from heat, add the appropriate amount of gelatin (Great Lakes Gelatin Type 8, Bloom 100), stir until dissolved; place each container in a 45 °C water bath for 1 h with agitation and occasional stirring.

steps.title: Gelatin infiltration via tissue processor
steps.instruction: Place tissue blocks into tissue baskets, load into a Leica TP1020 processor with an initial 4 % PFA container, and run an overnight program: Ultrapure water @25 °C – 2 h, Ultrapure water @25 °C – 4 h, 5 % gelatin @45 °C – 2 h, 10 % gelatin @45 °C – 2 h, 15 % gelatin @45 °C – 2 h. Time the program so it finishes the following morning.

steps.title: Peroxidase quenching and detergent permeabilization
steps.instruction: Rinse 3 × 10 min in PBS, incubate in a 3 % H₂O₂–methanol block (1:4) for 30 min to quench endogenous peroxidase, rinse 3 × 10 min in PBS, then soak 3–5 days in PBS containing 0.5 % Triton X‑100 and 0.08 % Na azide at 4 °C.

steps.title: DAB chromogen reaction
steps.instruction: Rinse 3 × 10 min in PBS, then react with DAB solution (0.7 mg ml⁻¹ DAB, 5.6 µg ml⁻¹ 3 % H₂O₂ in Tris‑buffered saline; DAB from Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #32750‑5G) for 90 min at 4 °C; rinse 3 × 10 min in cold distilled H₂O.

steps.title: Mount sections on gelatin‑coated slides
steps.instruction: Transfer 3–4 sections per gelatin‑coated glass slide, maintain consistent orientation, label with a pencil, and dry overnight; soak slides in 4 % PFA for 1 h, rinse 3 × with distilled H₂O, dry overnight, dehydrate 4 × 4 min in ethanol, then 2 × 6 min in xylene, and coverslip with Cytoseal XYL (Fisher Scientific Catalog #22‑050‑262).

steps.title: Gastrin immunostaining – blocking and primary
steps.instruction: Rinse 3 × 10 min in PBS; block 2 h with Avidin blocking solution (Vector SP‑2001); rinse 3 × 10 min PBS; block 2 h with Biotin blocking solution (same kit); rinse 3 × 10 min PBS; incubate primary Gastrin antibody (Guinea‑pig polyclonal, OriGene Catalog #BP5046) diluted 1:7,500 in 0.5 % PBST, 0.08 % Na azide, 5 % normal donkey serum (NDS), 2 % BSA for 3 days at 4 °C.

steps.title: Gastrin immunostaining – secondary and amplification
steps.instruction: Rinse 3 × 10 min PBS, then soak 48 h in 2 % PBST, 0.08 % Na azide, 5 % NGS (Goat serum, Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #G9023), 2 % BSA at 4 °C; rinse 3 × 10 min in 0.3 % PBST, incubate 48 h at 4 °C with Biotin‑anti‑Guinea‑Pig IgG (donkey, 1:500) in 0.5 % PBST, 0.08 % Na azide, 5 % NDS, 2 % BSA (Jackson ImmunoResearch Catalog #706‑065‑148); rinse 3 × 10 min 0.3 % PBST, then incubate 48 h at 4 °C in Vectastain Elite ABC HRP kit (bottles A and B diluted 1:50 in 0.5 % PBST, mixed 30 min before use).

steps.title: Gastrin DAB development
steps.instruction: Rinse 3 × 10 min PBS, develop with VECTOR® SG Peroxidase (HRP) Substrate Kit (Vector Catalog #SK‑4700) for 20 min, then rinse 3 × 10 min in cold distilled H₂O.

steps.title: Ghrelin immunostaining – blocking and primary
steps.instruction: Rinse 3 × 10 min PBS; block 2 h with Avidin blocking solution (Vector SP‑2001); rinse 3 × 10 min PBS; block 2 h with Biotin blocking solution (same kit); rinse 3 × 10 min PBS; incubate primary Ghrelin antibody (Rat/Mouse, Phoenix Pharmaceuticals Catalog #H‑031‑31) diluted 1:800 in 0.5 % PBST, 0.08 % Na azide, 5 % NGS, 2 % BSA for 3 days at 4 °C.

steps.title: Ghrelin immunostaining – secondary and amplification
steps.instruction: Rinse 3 × 10 min PBS, then soak 48 h in 0.3 % PBST, 0.08 % Na azide, 5 % NGS, 2 % BSA at 4 °C; rinse 3 × 10 min 0.3 % PBST, incubate 48 h at 4 °C with Biotin‑anti‑Rabbit IgG (donkey, 1:500) in 0.5 % PBST, 0.08 % Na azide, 5 % NGS, 2 % BSA (Jackson ImmunoResearch Catalog #111‑065‑144); rinse 3 × 10 min 0.3 % PBST, then incubate 48 h at 4 °C in Vectastain Elite ABC HRP kit (bottles A and B diluted 1:50 in 0.5 % PBST, mixed 30 min before use).

steps.title: Ghrelin DAB development
steps.instruction: Rinse 3 × 10 min PBS, develop with VECTOR® SG Peroxidase (HRP) Substrate Kit (Vector Catalog #SK‑4700) for 20 min, then rinse 3 × 10 min in cold distilled H₂O.

steps.title: Vibratome sectioning of gelatin blocks
steps.instruction: Twenty‑four hours after placement in 4 % PFA, move gelatin blocks into a water bath, section on a Leica VT1200 S vibratome at 100 µm thickness, and collect sections in PBS.

steps.title: Prepare 15 % gelatin molds
steps.instruction: Make 750 ml of 15 % gelatin containing 0.1 % thymol (as described for the other gelatin solutions) the next morning; fill Peel‑Away disposable embedding molds (Electron Microscopy Sciences, Catalog #70182) half‑way with this gelatin 30 min before the end of the tissue‑processing program, and refrigerate 30 min to harden.

steps.title: Embed tissue in gelatin blocks
steps.instruction: Fill the molds with the remaining 15 % gelatin, position tissue samples with the desired orientation, refrigerate 30 min to harden, carefully cut away the mold, and place the hardened gelatin block in 4 % PFA overnight.
